name: smwmusic-teenage-mutant-ninja-turtles-nes-underwater
title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (NES) - Underwater
description:
My custom port of the track Underwater from Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles for NES featured in GPW2.

This track comes from the panic-inducing dam level in TMNT and therefore would work well in any fast-paced level that contains water-based platforming.
